summary: Verified the navbar CTA duplication fix on the ROAR Expo home page across desktop (1920) and mobile (400) viewports. Desktop shows only 'Register as Visitor' and 'Register as Exhibitor'; 'Exhibit'/'Visit' are no longer visible on desktop. On mobile they are correctly hidden until the hamburger menu is opened, and the desktop CTA row is hidden. CTA buttons navigate to the correct routes.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: Consider adding data-testid attributes to navbar CTAs and hamburger toggle for more robust automated testing.
React Router future-flag warnings (v7_startTransition, v7_relativeSplatPath) are logged in console; harmless but could be opted-in to silence.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Navbar fix verified. Desktop viewport (1920x1080): .nav-cta visible with both Register buttons, .mobile-only-ctas hidden, no 'Exhibit'/'Visit' text in nav. Mobile viewport (400x844): .nav-cta hidden, after clicking hamburger .mobile-only-ctas visible with Exhibit and Visit. Register as Exhibitor -> /register/exhibitor. Register as Visitor -> /register/visitor. All 4 requested test cases passed.
rca of the issue: Original bug: inline style display:flex on .mobile-only-ctas overrode CSS rule display:none for desktop. Fix removed inline style and moved gap/margin into @media(max-width:900px) rule. Verified via viewport toggling that CSS media queries now correctly hide mobile-only CTAs on desktop and show them within the mobile hamburger menu.
